product.name: ReamurCMS Block Editor
product.implementation: native ReamurCMS editor; no WordPress runtime or package dependency
product.runtime_dependency_policy: no external CDN or third-party runtime dependency

legacy_conversion.on_edit: auto-convert in memory and show review/preview
legacy_conversion.unsupported_markup: preserve in legacy fragment or stop conversion and keep original; never silently drop
legacy_conversion.original_source: must remain recoverable until a separately approved cleanup

security.block_rendering: allowlisted server-side renderer with context-appropriate escaping
security.legacy_html: isolated conversion fallback; do not expand existing raw HTML trust boundary
security.csrf_and_acl: reuse blog/blog existing modify + CSRF flow

acceptance: existing blog HTML remains unchanged until user explicitly saves a conversion
each enabled language can contain a distinct versioned block document
2- and 3-column layouts stack on mobile and remain editable with keyboard
unknown/unsafe legacy markup is never silently discarded
block values cannot execute arbitrary HTML/JavaScript in public output
legacy content remains recoverable while the feature is introduced
no changes to CMS/page custom fields or other blog lifecycle behavior
